THE MG ZS RANGE
HAVE IT ALL
With a perfect blend of advanced 
technology, spacious design,  
and a refined driving experience,  
the MG ZS has it all. 
The evolution of MG’s compact SUV, the MG ZS features  
a unique new exterior and comes loaded with technology.  
With the choice of Petrol or Hybrid powertrains, MG ZS offers  
the best of both worlds.
Packed with features for a smarter drive
The MG ZS comes loaded with intelligent technology, including 
the MG Pilot Safety Systems and MG iSMART app connectivity, 
ensuring every drive is as connected and safe as possible.
With its smooth performance, stylish design, low running costs, 
and spacious interior, the MG ZS delivers a complete package 
that’s hard to beat. Plus, it all comes with the reassurance of  
our 7-year warranty.
A smooth drive, smart design, agile looks ... now you really can have it all.

05
Everything about the new MG ZS is designed  
to make each journey a joy.
Practical comfort
The new MG ZS gives you plenty of room to breathe. With a stylish and contemporary cabin,  
and up to 1,457 litres of boot space, it has more room for your family, luggage, or a set of golf clubs. 
Perfect for day-to-day living or a trip up the motorway for a well-earned break. 
Effortless performance
The innovative engine within the Hybrid+ model works seamlessly to give low fuel consumption,  
low CO
2
 emissions and class-leading power and performance. Not to mention a quiet,  
comfortable drive every time.
Advanced technology
The MG ZS is loaded with intelligent technology to enhance your driving experience.  
Be safer with the latest MG Pilot driver assistance, be informed with MG iSMART,  
and be in total control with the upgraded 12.3" touchscreen.
  Made to give you more  MG ZS

MADE TO GIVE YOU MORE

07
  A bold new look  MG ZS
A BOLD NEW LOOK
The bold new styling of the new  
MG ZS builds on the distinctive 
new design language of the MG3  
and the MG HS range. 
The flawless lines and long wheelbase create an air of effortless 
confidence. The wider front grille, rear spoiler and slim LED 
headlamps add bold aesthetic flourishes.
Meanwhile, the elegantly balanced body rests on 18* alloy wheels, 
designed to enhance aerodynamics as well as looks.
*17" alloy wheels on SE models

MG ZS 
 
 
  A more refined interior  
 
08
*For full specification per version, please refer to technical  
specifications at the rear of this brochure.
Discover the refined interior  
of the MG ZS 
Inside the sleek profile of the MG ZS, you’ll discover 
intelligently crafted new features - such as the wing 
style drive selector and a heated steering wheel*.
At the heart of the sophisticated interior are leather-
style heated front seats that give you 6-way electric 
adjustability*. You’re also surrounded by high-gloss 
panels and chrome detailing, while the multi-functional 
soft-touch steering wheel invites you to take control.
A MORE REFINED INTERIOR
Family breaks and other long journeys 
are now even more enjoyable with the 
exceptional boot space of the MG ZS. 
Open the boot and you have 443 litres of space, increasing to a total 
of 1,457 litres with the rear seats folded. Ideal for the weekly shop, 
family luggage, or even a mountain bike. 
All this comes with smart storage solutions throughout the cabin. 
Including an adjustable cup holder and an armrest tray at the front 
that both flex for the perfect fit.
PLENTY OF STORAGE
09
  A more refined interior  MG ZS 
Interior: MG ZS Hybrid+ model.

A WORLD OF TECHNOLOGY
Technology is smartest when it puts people at its centre. In the MG ZS,  
you’ll find all the controls and information you need at your fingertips.
*Available on MG ZS SE Petrol and MG ZS Trophy Hybrid+.
11
  A world of technology  MG ZS
360° camera*
Parking spots and narrow streets are no hassle with four 
HD wide cameras to give you an all-round view. Meanwhile, 
ultrasonic radar warns you about obstructions, and Dynamic 
Reversing Assist helps you park at the perfect angle.
Apple CarPlay™ and Android Auto™
Apple CarPlay™ and Android Auto™ in the MG ZS  
effortlessly connects your smartphone to the vehicle.  
Enjoy convenient access to navigation, music, news,  
and weather, all through the MG ZS interface designed  
to deliver a smooth and responsive experience making  
every drive enjoyable and safe.
12.3" screen
The hub of your intelligent cabin is a new 12.3" HD infotainment 
screen. With an intuitive design, you can access everything from 
sat-nav directions to your favourite music while driving safely. 
Apple CarPlay™, Android Auto™, Bluetooth, DAB radio and 
more...it’s all there with a tap.
7" display
The highly intuitive 7" HD virtual cluster displays clear,  
concise driving information – and enables you to switch 
between 3 driving modes - while making it easy to control  
your phone, music and other infotainment.
Interiors: MG ZS Hybrid+ model.

SMARTER HYBRID POWER
The new MG ZS Hybrid+ brings together leading engine technologies to deliver  
best-in-class performance and exceptional fuel economy.
The advanced hybrid powertrain gives you five operating levels which switch automatically for optimum performance depending  
on your journey. Whether you’re on the school run or heading out-of-town for the weekend, your engine adapts to give you an 
effortless drive every time.
Better for the environment and 
your running costs
In the MG ZS Hybrid+, you’ll shrink your 
carbon footprint by using fewer fossil fuels 
- and create zero tailpipe emissions in fully 
electric mode. You’ll spend less money at the 
pump too. And lower emissions mean you also 
spend less money on road tax, compared to 
conventional petrol and diesel cars.

DRIVING 
WITH A 
BIG PLUS
Here’s how our advanced 
Hybrid+ system gives 
you a better drive on  
so many levels.
  Hybrid PLUS  MG ZS
Performance
The 100kW electric motor and 75kW combustion engine deliver more power as well as seamless electric torque at 
city speeds, perfect for school runs. Giving you ultra-refined performance without having a negative impact on fuel 
economy and emissions.
Low emissions
With just 115g/km of CO
2
, your emissions are far lower than a comparable petrol car – and you could save on tax and 
low-emission zone fees. The MG ZS Hybrid+ also keeps things low when it comes to running costs, with combined 
fuel consumption of 55.4MPG. 
Ultra-efficient
The MG ZS Hybrid+ is designed to leave the rest behind. It’s one of the most efficient hybrid models in its class, 
thanks to the quick-response motor and 3-speed hybrid transmission.
Smooth 
The MG ZS Hybrid+ gives you the instant response and effortless acceleration of a fully electric vehicle.  
Thanks to the high-capacity 1.83kWh battery, you can feel more EV more of the time. When it comes to  
town driving, for example, being in EV mode transforms stop-start traffic into a smooth, stress-free experience.

The innovative MG iSMART system is a beautifully simple

The MG iSMART system integrates car and user communication, and the dedicated MG

AFTERCARE
7 year warranty
To help you love every effortless mile in your MG ZS, we give you the peace of mind of our  
full 7 year or 80,000 mile warranty, whichever comes first. Our specialist technicians will be  
on-hand to keep your MG ZS performing at its best. It’s also fully transferable to future owners.
MG Service Plans
Enjoy hassle-free motoring and avoid unexpected costs with an MG Service Plan.  
You can protect your MG ZS for up to 7 years with a mileage range of your choice.  
And our MG authorised repairer network offers genuine parts and factory-trained  
staff to keep your car in peak condition.
